liturgicalName: The Ascension of the Lord (Thursday or 7th Sunday of Easter where transferred)
keyVerseDR: "Go ye into the whole world and preach the gospel to every creature." (Mk 16:15)

level1.title: Jesus Goes to Heaven
level1.story: Jesus told His friends, "Go into the whole world and tell the Good News!" Then He was taken up into heaven. The disciples went out and preached everywhere.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: Who can you tell about Jesus?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me share Your good news. Amen.

activity.title: Share the Good News
items: Tell someone one thing about Jesus

level2.title: Go Into the Whole World
level2.story: Jesus said to the Eleven, "Go ye into the whole world, and preach the gospel to every creature." He said whoever believes and is baptized shall be saved. Signs would follow those who believe, and they would lay hands on the sick and heal them. The Lord Jesus was taken up into heaven and sat at the right hand of God. The disciples went forth and preached everywhere, and the Lord worked with them.
level2.keyLine: Go ye into the whole world and preach the gospel.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why didn't Jesus stay on earth?
How does the Lord work with us?
level2.prayer: Jesus, seated at God's right hand, send me out. Amen.

activity.title: Good News board game
activity.intro: Roll a die, move, and answer a question about the Gospel.
